name: @radware/f5-to-alteon
description: Migrate an F5 BIG-IP (tmsh) configuration to Radware Alteon CLI - accepts qkview/UCS archives, config folders, or bare conf files; converts virtuals, pools, monitors, persistence, SSL, SNAT, VLANs/routes, route domains (segmentation or per-RD split) and wildcard virtuals (filters).

scripts.test: node --test test/golden.test.js test/unit.test.js test/extract.test.js test/newconstructs.test.js test/sample02.test.js
